A '''human''' was a command crew of [[Myn Weaver]], who operated on the [[planet]] [[Corellia]] as a [[Regional Supervisor]] for the [[New Republic]]. She was secretly an [[Galactic Empire|Imperial]] loyalist who worked for the [[witch]] [[Morgan Elsbeth]] and her [[Morgan Elsbeth's forces|forces]]. When [[Ahsoka Tano]] and [[Hera Syndulla]] investigated about droids and discovered that hyperdrives were being secretly shipped, this loyalist claimed she could not prevent [[Transport CT-O5]] from leaving, as it was cleared for departure, then, when Hera insisted, she and her allies attacked them. She was killed by Ahsoka in the scuffle.<ref name="Part Two" />
